about_short_description.short_description: Stackshine is the new operating system for enterprise IT teams.

product.name: Software Spend Management Platform
product.description: A platform that provides visibility into software costs and usage, automates onboarding/offboarding, and optimizes software spend.

product.name: SaaS Spend Optimization
product.description: Identifies and eliminates unnecessary costs, duplicate software licenses, and shadow applications through dashboard insights.

product.name: Software Catalog
product.description: A centralized catalog for employees to request access to approved software, helping manage software sprawl.

product.name: Automated Onboarding & Offboarding
product.description: Automates the provisioning and deprovisioning of software licenses for new and departing employees.

product.name: Notifications
product.description: Alerts for new subscriptions, upcoming renewals, and unusual charges to optimize SaaS spend.

product.name: Spending Insights
product.description: Provides insights into spending, usage, and licenses at both aggregate and department levels for effective subscription management.
